behavior.arguments: rdi = base pointer. If byte [rdi+0x240] == 1, (rax, rdx) = ([rdi+0x308], [rdi+0x310]); otherwise rax = [rdi+0xa0] + ([rdi+0xa8] - (8 if byte [rdi+0xd8] == 0 else 0) - [rdi+0x300]) with 64-bit wrapping, rdx = [rdi+0x300].

branch_targets.adjust_je: je at offset 0x22 (2 bytes, disp 0x14) lands on the adjust block at offset 0x38 (0x50fa298).
branch_targets.join_jmp: jmp at offset 0x3c (2 bytes, disp 0xe6 = -26) lands on the shared tail at offset 0x24 (0x50fa284); a backward join, not a loop, since the tail falls through to ret with no cycle back.
branch_targets.stored_je: je at offset 0x0b (2 bytes, disp 0x33) lands on the stored-pair block at offset 0x40 (0x50fa2a0).

edges.computed_no_adjust: flag 0, base 0x1000, span 0x100, adjust byte 5, limit 0x40 -> (0x10c0, 0x40).
edges.computed_with_adjust: flag 0, base 0x1000, span 0x100, adjust byte 0, limit 0x40 -> (0x10b8, 0x40).
edges.flag_other: flag 2 takes the computed path: base 0x1000, span 0x100, adjust byte 0, limit 0x40 -> (0x10b8, 0x40); only exactly 1 selects the stored pair.
edges.wrapping_cursor: flag 0, base 0x10, span 0x8, adjust byte 0, limit 0x40 -> (0x10 + 0 - 0x40) wrapped to 64 bits, 0x40.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; two forward je branches plus one backward jmp join; no calls: endbr64; cmpb $0x1,0x240(%rdi); je stored; cmpb $0x0,0xd8(%rdi); mov 0xa8(%rdi),%rdx; mov 0xa0(%rdi),%rax; je adjust; mov 0x300(%rdi),%rcx; sub %rcx,%rdx; add %rdx,%rax; mov %rcx,%rdx; ret; nopl; sub $0x8,%rdx; jmp shared tail; xchg; mov 0x310(%rdi),%rcx; mov 0x308(%rdi),%rax; mov %rcx,%rdx; ret.
behavior.return_rule: Both paths converge on the same (rax, rdx) pair shape: stored (base, limit) on the flag==1 path, computed cursor plus limit otherwise. No field is written on any path.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: One R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries). It is reported as a slot list only; no meaning is claimed for the table it belongs to.
